comparisons.name: go-to-folder-light
comparisons.description: Finder's Go to Folder dialog, the whole window capture with its shadow, Aqua. The capture's field is a combo box, which is another component: a text field stands in for it and the mask covers it with its focus ring.

comparisons.name: go-to-folder-light-layout
comparisons.description: As go-to-folder-light with the title, the label and the button titles masked as well, to score the frame, the shadow, the title bar and the button row alone: text is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.

comparisons.name: connect-to-server-light
comparisons.description: Finder's Connect to Server dialog, the modeless kind with window controls, the whole window capture with its shadow, Aqua. The address field (a combo box, with its focus ring), the list of favourite servers and the segmented add, remove and action control are other components: the example leaves room for them and the masks cover them.

comparisons.name: connect-to-server-light-layout
comparisons.description: As connect-to-server-light with the title, the label, the button titles and the help glyph masked as well, to score the frame, the shadow, the title bar with its window controls and the button row alone: text is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.
